body:
@gsmet @geoand any chance that someone can look into this? 

IMHO this issue is a blocker for all enterprises which rely on proxys and authentication ...
cc @aloubyansky (also @dmlloyd since this might be related to [Beanbag](https://github.com/smallrye/smallrye-beanbag))
Which Maven version was tested? `3.8.8` or `3.9.x`?

It would appear that the proxy information is being specified into the proxy selector correctly, including authentication information. The only thing that immediately springs to mind is that perhaps directly using the `SettingsDecrypterImpl` to obtain the proxy credentials is somehow a problem (like, it's decrypting the password incorrectly perhaps?) - maybe we should be querying the bean container for a `SettingsDescrypter` instead, and using that to produce the request and process the result?

If there is a problem with the decryption, it *should* be logging that at debug, so maybe try running `mvn` with the `-X` switch to see if there is more information or a line like "Failed to decrypt password for server ...".

I've tested the following combinations:              

| Maven| Quarkus| Result |
|---------|------|---|
| 3.8.8           | 2.16.7.Final     |  ✔ |
| 3.9.1     |  2.16.7.Final    |  ✖ |
| 3.8.8     |  3.0.2.Final    |  ✖ |
| 3.9.1     |  3.0.2.Final    |  ✖ |

As mentioned, in my reproducer u can use ``mvnw`` which uses `` Maven 3.8.8`` ..

issue.title: Use the container-provided settings decrypter
